title: Cup comparison of the fixed right external Cech sequences
statement: For $k,X,Y,f,g,F$ and any short complex $S$ of quasi-coherent modules on $Y$, and finite affine covers $U,V$ with affine diagonals, set $T=S.map(A)$ and $P=S.map(B)$ using [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. There are three normalized maps $d_r$ [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain], a morphism $\psi:T\to P$, and natural-degree homology isomorphisms $a_r:H^n(T.X_r)\cong H^n(\operatorname{picardExternalTotal}(F,S.X_r))$, $b_r:H^n(P.X_r)\cong H^n(\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(F\boxtimes S.X_r))$ [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model], such that $H^n(\psi.\tau_r)=a_r.hom\,H^n(d_r)\,b_r.inv$. Neither short exactness nor cup invertibility is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech (33.29.1.1) and the following coefficient sequence diagram; official tag page read

proof.text: Refine the factor pullback covers to the product cover and use the signed cup pairing. Coefficient naturality produces the three commuting components of psi. Pullback and tensor preserve quasi-coherence; the product intersections are affine.

Use natural affine Cech comparisons and the scalar resolution model comparison to identify the product homologies with the scalar models. Compare the two tensor totals using the factor comparisons and tensor Kunneth. Extension homology isomorphisms give a_r and b_r in natural degrees.

Choose normalized d_r using the cochain existence theorem. The Cech refinement/cup compatibility identifies psi on factor tensor cycles with external cup, the same formula as the normalization of d_r. Tensor Kunneth, surjective homology projections and pure tensor spanning establish each conjugation equation on all classes. Empty schemes and zero coefficients are handled by the same formulas.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED, explicit fixed Cech models and the right-variable version of the coefficient diagram

lean.statement:
theorem picardExternal_right_cech_comparison
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (V j))
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤)
    :
    ∃ (d1 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₁ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₁)),
    ∃ (d2 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₂ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₂)),
    ∃ (d3 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₃ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₃)),
    let T := S.map (picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F)
    let P := S.map (picardRightProductCechFunctor f g U V F)
    ∃ (ψ : T ⟶ P)
      (a1 : ∀ n : ℕ, T.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₁).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b1 : ∀ n : ℕ, P.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₁)).homology (n : ℤ))
      (a2 : ∀ n : ℕ, T.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₂).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b2 : ∀ n : ℕ, P.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₂)).homology (n : ℤ))
      (a3 : ∀ n : ℕ, T.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₃).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b3 : ∀ n : ℕ, P.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₃)).homology (n : ℤ)),
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₁ d1 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₂ d2 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₃ d3 ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ψ.τ₁ (n : ℤ) =
        (a1 n).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d1 (n : ℤ) ≫ (b1 n).inv) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ψ.τ₂ (n : ℤ) =
        (a2 n).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d2 (n : ℤ) ≫ (b2 n).inv) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ψ.τ₃ (n : ℤ) =
        (a3 n).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d3 (n : ℤ) ≫ (b3 n).inv)
